## Reproduction machinery

Python standard library and Git only. Reconstruct `/tmp/sorok-rc1/<SHARD>/` inputs from the exact return cuts in the manifest and `rows.json` by concatenating their `01_BRANCH_ROWS.json.rows` while adding each `shard`. Extract the three original census JSON files and heuristic manifest from31525145 at the original `PYAT_CONTROL_ROOM/FINAL_PRODUCTION_ARCHITECTURE_HQ_20261028_R1/CROSS_BRANCH_INHERITANCE/` path. Run the source-analysis passes below in order. Fresh refs are time-sensitive; compare historical freshness with05, rather than expecting a later live remote view to be identical. The observed frozen source comparisons and byte checks use immutable cuts. Scripts write temporary analysis only plus this return directory; never execute source modules.

def changes(a,b):

  if not raw[i]:continue
  om,nm,ob,nb,st=raw[i].decode().split();out.append({'path':raw[i+1].decode(errors='replace'),'old_blob':ob,'new_blob':nb,'status':st})
 return out
BT=tree(BASE); aliases=collections.defaultdict(list)
for path,v in BT.items():aliases[v[2]].append(path)
basecode={p:v for p,v in BT.items() if iscode(p)}

for n,row in enumerate(ROWS):

 tip=git('show','--format=','--name-only',sha).decode().splitlines()
 inspected=[]
 for x in row.get('inspected_paths',[]):
  path=x.get('path') if isinstance(x,dict) else x
  if path in t:inspected.append({'path':path,'blob':t[path][2],'premain_aliases':aliases[t[path][2]]})
 roots=set();candidates=set()
 for field in ['source_candidates','actual_code_paths','source_code_paths_in_head_commit']:
  for path in row.get(field,[]):
   if isinstance(path,str):candidates.add(path)
 for field in ['primary_source_path','original_return_path','original_pinned_document_path']:
  path=row.get(field)
  if path:candidates.add(path)
 candidates|={x['path'] for x in inspected}
 for path in candidates:
  bits=path.split('/')
  if bits[0] in ['WORKER_RETURNS','REVIEWS'] and len(bits)>2:roots.add('/'.join(bits[:2])+'/')
  elif path in t and iscode(path):roots.add(str(pathlib.PurePosixPath(path).parent)+'/')
 selected={p:v for p,v in t.items() if iscode(p) and (p in candidates or any(p.startswith(root) for root in roots))}
 codes=[]
 for path,v in selected.items():
  blob=v[2];codes.append({'path':path,'blob':blob,'test_or_harness_hint':istest(path),'premain_same_blob_aliases':aliases[blob]})
  if blob not in blobproofs:
   content=git('cat-file','blob',blob);symbols=[];imports=[];calls=[];astsha=None;err=None

    try:

 paths_to_read=[row.get('original_pinned_document_path'),row.get('original_return_path')]

 if n%50==0:print('processed',n,flush=True)
(P/'full_comparisons.json').write_text(json.dumps(result));(P/'packages.json').write_text(json.dumps(packages));(P/'blobproofs.json').write_text(json.dumps(blobproofs));(P/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(LOG));print('DONE',len(result),'packages',sum(bool(p['code_files']) for p in packages),'unique code blobs',len(blobproofs),flush=True)

   tr=git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',sha,'SOROK_PRODUCT_CONTROL_ROOM','WORKER_RETURNS','V3','src','src_v3','rawlsing','tests','FIELD_FORGE_CONTROL_ROOM','PRE_V3_CONTROL_ROOM'); scopepaths=tr.stdout.decode(errors='replace').splitlines()
  cache[sha]={'status':'PATH_HITS_REQUIRE_SOURCE_READ' if hits else 'NO_TIP_PATH_HIT__ANCESTRAL_CONTENT_NOT_CLEARED','metadata':{'tree':meta[1],'parents':meta[2].split(),'subject':meta[3] if len(meta)>3 else ''},'tip_paths':paths,'relevant_tip_paths':hits,'code_tip_paths':codes,'selected_tree_path_count':len(scopepaths),'selected_tree_path_digest':hashlib.sha256('\n'.join(scopepaths).encode()).hexdigest() if scopepaths else None,'relevant_tree_paths':[p for p in scopepaths if re.search('sorok|actor|field.?forge|source_binding|rule_[at]|pff|sdtf',p,re.I)][:100],'source_review':'NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_SOURCE_REVIEWED_BY_METADATA_SCAN'}
 out.append({'name':x['name'],'pinned_sha':sha,'pool':pool,'current_sha':fresh.get(x['name']),'freshness':'DELETED_OR_UNADVERTISED' if x['name'] not in fresh else ('UNCHANGED' if fresh[x['name']]==sha else 'MOVED'),'screen':cache[sha]})

import json,subprocess,pathlib,re,hashlib,ast,collections
P=pathlib.Path('/tmp/sorok-rc1');rows=json.loads((P/'outside.json').read_text());out=[];logs=[]
def git(*a):

for row in rows:
 if row['pool']!='HEURISTIC_168':continue
 sha=row['pinned_sha'];s=row['screen'];paths=s['tip_paths'];docs=[p for p in paths if p.endswith('.md')];codes=s.get('code_tip_paths',[])
 # Primary return or authority report at the actual tip; no raw corpus reading.
 docs.sort(key=lambda x:(0 if re.search(r'00_RETURN|REPORT|VERDICT|REVIEW|HANDOFF|STATUS|AUTHORITY|SUMMARY',x,re.I) else 1,len(x)))
 chosen=docs[:2];sources=[]
 for path in chosen:
  b=git('show',sha+':'+path);blob=git('rev-parse',sha+':'+path).decode().strip();text=b.decode(errors='replace');ls=text.splitlines()
  excerpts=[{'line':i,'text':l} for i,l in enumerate(ls,1) if re.search('HOLD|REVISE|RED|ACCEPT|canonical|adopt|consumer|actor|CAN008|ADP|SOURCE|issuer|grant',l,re.I)]
  sources.append({'path':path,'blob':blob,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'lines':len(ls),'qualification_excerpts':excerpts[:30],'full_text_read_by_local_parser':True})
 codeproof=[]
 for path in codes[:3]:
  b=git('show',sha+':'+path);blob=git('rev-parse',sha+':'+path).decode().strip();symbols=[];imports=[]
  if path.endswith('.py'):
   try:
    m=ast.parse(b);symbols=[{'name':n.name,'line':n.lineno} for n in ast.walk(m) if isinstance(n,(ast.ClassDef,ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef))];imports=[{'line':n.lineno,'source':ast.unparse(n)} for n in ast.walk(m) if isinstance(n,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom))]
   except Exception:pass
  codeproof.append({'path':path,'blob':blob,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'symbols':symbols,'imports':imports,'grade':'STATIC_SOURCE_STRUCTURE__NOT_SEMANTIC_ACCEPTANCE'})
 out.append({'name':row['name'],'cut':sha,'source_documents':sources,'code_sources':codeproof,'triage':'DOCUMENTARY_AND_CODE_STRUCTURE_PROVISIONAL' if sources or codeproof else 'HOLD_NO_AUTHORED_NONCORPUS_TIP_SOURCE__ANCESTRAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED','source_scope':'TIP_CHANGED_SOURCES_ONLY__NOT_FULL_HISTORY_OR_SCIENTIFIC_REVIEW','consumer_connection':'NOT_PROVED_UNLESS_CURATED_EDGE_BELOW','next_source_slots':codes[3:]+docs[2:]})
(P/'triage168.json').write_text(json.dumps(out));(P/'triage_commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(logs));print('168',len(out),'docs',sum(len(r['source_documents']) for r in out),'code',sum(len(r['code_sources']) for r in out))
print('missing_source_count',sum(not r['source_documents'] and not r['code_sources'] for r in out))
print('outside counts',collections.Counter(r['screen']['status'] for r in rows))

for p in packs:
 # All package roots already selected from source-return evidence; never data corpora.
 roots=[r for r in p['source_roots'] if r.startswith(('WORKER_RETURNS/','REVIEWS/'))]
 if not roots:continue
 r=subprocess.run(['git','ls-tree','-r','-z',p['cut'],*roots],capture_output=True);logs.append({'argv':['git','ls-tree','-r','-z',p['cut'],*roots],'exit':r.returncode})
 archives=[]
 for line in r.stdout.split(b'\0'):
  if not line:continue
  m,path=line.split(b'\t',1);path=path.decode();blob=m.decode().split()[2]
  if not re.search(r'\.(tar\.gz|tgz|tar\.xz|tar|zip)$',path):continue
  if blob not in cache:
   cp=subprocess.run(['git','cat-file','blob',blob],capture_output=True);logs.append({'argv':['git','cat-file','blob',blob],'exit':cp.returncode});b=cp.stdout;members=[];err=None
   try:
    if path.endswith('.zip'):
     z=zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(b));fs=[(n,z.read(n)) for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith(('.py','.sql','.js','.ts'))]
    else:
     z=tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(b),mode='r:*');fs=[(n.name,z.extractfile(n).read()) for n in z.getmembers() if n.isfile() and n.name.endswith(('.py','.sql','.js','.ts'))]
    for name,data in fs:members.append({'name':name,'git_blob_sha1':hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\0'+data).hexdigest(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(data)})
   except Exception as e:err=str(e)
   cache[blob]={'archive_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'source_members':members,'error':err,'member_content_set_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted(set(x['sha256'] for x in members))).encode()).hexdigest()}
  archives.append({'path':path,'blob':blob,'archive_proof_id':blob})
 if archives:out.append({'branch':p['branch'],'cut':p['cut'],'archives':archives})
(P/'archives.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rows':out,'archive_contents':cache}));(P/'archive_commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(logs));print('archive branches',len(out),'unique archives',len(cache),'source members',sum(len(v['source_members']) for v in cache.values()),'errors',[k for k,v in cache.items() if v['error']])

## Publication boundary

Only `WORKER_RETURNS/SOROK-294-R2-RC1/**` may enter this branch commit. Eight payload files are committed first;08 then binds their exact immutable payload commit and content hashes. The final nine-file remote SHA is verified and reported after ordinary non-force push. Neither publication nor this structural validation starts HR1, confers independent acceptance, changes PR514/516, integrates code or mutates PRE-MAIN. Temporary audit products remain outside the repository under `/tmp/sorok-rc1`; they are not unstaged source edits.
